html:
A rebellion of Tuareg groups in northern Niger and Mali from 1990 to 1995, demanding a share of power and of the wealth of the north.

In Niger it began after an attack on the police post of Tchin-Tabaradene in May 1990, to which the army responded by killing many Tuareg civilians. Many Tuareg had come home from Libya and Algeria, some with military training, after the droughts destroyed their herds. Fighting and talks went on until a peace accord in 1995 promised more local rule and jobs in the army. Many promises were not kept, and a new revolt began in 2007. The grievances over uranium and neglect remain.
sum: A rebellion of Tuareg groups in northern Niger and Mali from 1990 to 1995, demanding a share of power and of the wealth of the north.
